annotations.title: Hand a move to my coding session

description: One move of a site's plan as a complete, self-contained brief for a coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor): the goal, the page or change, the exact questions it targets and which AIs missed them, the rivals recommended, the pages the AIs read (to study, not copy), page anatomy and schema, what not to do (no invented facts, prices or reviews), and how aipozi will measure it. In a coding session opened on the site's repo, implement it, then call mark_move_done. Default: the top move. Paid sites only, as in the app.

move.description: The move id from action_plan or briefing ("comparison", "page-p03"), or its rank ("1"). Leave it out for the top move.

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

name: build_prompt

measure.description: How aipozi measures it and the mark_move_done call to make.

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

prompt.description: The brief, ready to paste or act on.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).
